name: White Bean Palak Curry
ingredients: 1½ cups cooked white beans (cannellini or navy)
½ tsp coriander powder, ¼ tsp turmeric and ¼ tsp chilli powder
steps: Heat the oil, crackle the cumin, and cook the onion for 5 minutes. Add ginger and garlic.
Add the tomato and spices and cook for 5 minutes.
Add the spinach and cook for 4 minutes until wilted.
Add the beans and ½ cup water and simmer for 8 minutes; mash a few beans to thicken.
Finish with garam masala, lemon juice and salt.
note: Canned beans work well: rinse them thoroughly to remove excess sodium.
